questions.stem: Why do you need those coins?

options.B: Because I want to make some phone calls.

questions.explain:
coin: 硬幣
make a phone call: 打電話
解析：題目問「你為什麼需要那些硬幣？」投幣式公用電話需要零錢，說明用途合乎常理，故答案選B。選項C回答「因為那是我的」並未解釋需要的原因；選項A的熱門話題與選項D的想法皆與硬幣無關，屬文不對題的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Does it annoy you when people smoke in your presence?

options.A: No, I've never smoked in my life.
options.C: No, I won't do it again.
options.D: Yes, I hate it when people do so.

questions.explain:
annoy: 惹惱、使心煩
in one's presence: 當著某人的面、在場
解析：題目詢問「有人當著你的面抽菸會惹惱你嗎？」。選項D表示「會，我討厭別人這樣做」，語意最相符，故答案選D。干擾選項A與B誤將焦點放在「自己」抽不抽菸；選項C則是道歉並承諾不再犯，皆屬答非所問。

questions.stem: What do you usually use to hit nails into wood?
questions.explain:
nail: 釘子
hammer: 鐵鎚
screwdriver: 螺絲起子
解析：題目問「通常用什麼把釘子打進木頭裡？」。敲打釘子要使用鐵鎚，故答案選A。選項B螺絲起子、C耙子、D鋸子皆為常見工具，此題為同類字彙的干擾陷阱，功能均不符合敲釘子的需求。

questions.stem: How can you stand the heat in summer?

options.A: I sit down whenever I can.

questions.explain:
stand: 忍受
be used to: 習慣於
heat: 酷熱、高溫
解析：題目問「你夏天怎麼受得了這種酷熱？」，動詞stand在此指「忍受」，回答習慣了最符合語境，故答案選D。選項A利用stand字面「站立」的反義詞sit down設計字面陷阱；B與C則答非所問。

questions.stem: What do you call a person whose job is to make things from wood?
questions.explain:
carpenter: 木匠
make things from wood: 用木頭製作物品
designer: 設計師
解析：題目詢問以製作木製品為工作的人稱為什麼。木匠的英文是 carpenter，故答案選 C。干擾選項皆為其他常見職業，A 為演員，B 為部落客，D 為設計師，皆與題目要求的木工專業無關。

questions.stem: Have you ever been on TV?

options.A: No, I don't watch much TV.
options.D: Yes, I've appeared several times on a talk show.

questions.explain:
be on TV: 上電視
appear: 出現、演出
talk show: 脫口秀
解析：題目問「你曾上過電視嗎？」，be on TV 指在電視上亮相或表演，D 表達曾多次在訪談節目露面，符合題意，故答案選D。干擾選項 A 為常見字面陷阱，誤將上電視理解為「看電視（watch TV）」；B「我正要下去」與 C「我不夠富有」皆答非所問。

questions.stem: How long have your parents been married?

options.A: They come to visit once in a while.
options.C: They are going to celebrate their wedding anniversary.

questions.explain:
How long: 多久（詢問時間長度）
decade: 十年
once in a while: 偶爾
解析：題目詢問父母結婚多久了，是在問時間長度，因此以「For three decades（三十年）」回答最恰當，答案選B。選項A回答頻率（多常來訪），選項D回答結婚次數，均為混淆疑問詞的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Have you ever worked for a charity?

options.A: No, I've never worked for profit.
options.B: Yes, I've worked for the Red Cross since 2008.
options.C: No, my charity isn't all about money.
options.D: Yes, I think charity should begin at home.

questions.explain:
charity: 慈善機構；慈善
Red Cross: 紅十字會
profit: 利潤；營利
解析：題意詢問「你曾在慈善機構工作過嗎？」。Red Cross（紅十字會）為知名慈善組織，正面回答工作經歷最合邏輯，答案選B。A選項混淆營利概念；C與D選項則利用charity字面延伸哲理或諺語，皆屬答非所問的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: Are you afraid of Friday the 13th?

options.C: No, I don't eat meat on Fridays.
options.D: Yes, I have plans for the weekend.

questions.explain:
Friday the 13th: 十三號星期五（黑色星期五）
superstitious: 迷信的
be afraid of: 害怕
解析：題目問「你害怕十三號星期五嗎？」，該日期在西方文化中象徵不吉利，因此回答不迷信最符合語境，答案選A。干擾項B提到懼高（heights）、C提到星期五不吃肉、D回答週末有計畫，皆偏離迷信主題，為字面或無關干擾。

questions.stem: Has your daughter reached legal age?

options.A: No, she is not very confident.
options.B: Yes, she is already 21 years old.
options.C: No, she is not familiar with legal matters.

questions.explain:
reach: 達到
legal age: 法定年齡
解析：題意為「你女兒達到法定年齡了嗎？」。答案選B，因為21歲代表已成年，符合核心問題。選項C利用題目出現的legal製造字面陷阱，扯到法律事務；選項A的自信與選項D的友善皆與年齡無關，答非所問。

questions.stem: How often do you check your Facebook account?

options.A: I create an account every two months.
options.B: There's still some money in my bank account.
options.C: I have to check with the accountant.

questions.explain:
How often: 多常（詢問頻率）
account: 帳號、帳戶
accountant: 會計師
解析：題目詢問多常查看臉書帳號。How often 詢問發生頻率，回答頻率的 Almost every day 最合理，答案選D。干擾選項 A 答非所問；B 與 C 利用 account 的另一個意思「銀行帳戶」及同根詞 accountant「會計師」製造字面混淆陷阱。

questions.stem: Do you read books based on recommendations?

options.A: Yes, I need people to recommend me.
options.B: No, I write books based on my own experience.
options.D: No, I choose books to read on my own.

questions.explain:
based on: 根據、以…為基礎
recommendation: 推薦、介紹
on one's own: 靠自己、獨自
解析：題目問「你讀書是根據別人的推薦嗎？」選項D回答「不，我都自己挑書讀」，切合邏輯，故答案選D。干擾項A的 recommend me 意為推薦「我」這個人，語意錯誤；B將「讀書」偷換成「寫書」；C則答非所問扯到傳記。

questions.stem: Are those people your in-laws?

options.A: Yes, they're my law office colleagues.
options.B: No, they're not interested in legal matters.
options.C: Yes, they're my wife's brothers and sister.
options.D: No, they're not lonely at all.

questions.explain:
in-laws: 姻親（配偶的家人）
colleague: 同事
legal: 法律的
解析：題意詢問那些人是否為你的姻親。妻子的手足即是配偶的家人，故答案選C。選項A與B是利用law（法律）製造字面陷阱；D則是lonely（寂寞的）發音混淆。

questions.stem: Are expensive things always good?
questions.explain:
It depends: 看情況而定
a matter of time: 時間問題
解析：題目問「貴的東西總是好的嗎？」答案選A。It depends 意為「看情況」，適當回應事物並非絕對。干擾選項B「只是時間問題」與D「這是原則問題」皆答非所問、文不對題；C「它有效」則無法回答此通則問題。

questions.stem: Is Tom a well-behaved child?

options.A: Yes, he believes everything he hears.
options.B: No, he is not naughty at all.
options.D: No, he is not young any longer.

questions.explain:
well-behaved: 守規矩的、乖巧的
obedient: 服從的、順從的
naughty: 頑皮的
解析：題目問「湯姆是個乖小孩嗎？」。well-behaved 與 obedient 意思相近，皆表示聽話懂事，故答案選C。選項A用音近詞 believes 混淆；選項B回答 No 卻說「一點也不頑皮」，邏輯矛盾；選項D扯到年齡，答非所問。

questions.stem: What should you use to cut cloth?
questions.explain:
cloth: 布料
scissors: 剪刀
pincers: 鉗子
解析：題意問「你應該用什麼來剪布料？」裁切布料需使用剪刀，故答案選A。主要干擾選項B手套與C短褲為衣物配件，無切割功能；D鐵鉗通常用於拔釘或夾持金屬硬物，不適合用來剪布。

questions.stem: What sports did you play on the beach?
questions.explain:
volleyball: 排球
beach: 海灘
hockey: 曲棍球
解析：題意為「你在海灘上玩了什麼運動？」。答案選B，排球是常見的海灘運動（沙灘排球）。選項A野餐與選項D音樂都不是運動；選項C曲棍球通常在冰上或草地進行，不符合海灘情境。

questions.stem: Do you smell something burning?

options.C: Oh, no! I forgot to turn off the gas stove!
options.D: Sorry, I didn't mean to hurt you.

questions.explain:
smell something burning: 聞到燒焦味
gas stove: 瓦斯爐
turn off: 關掉
解析：題意為「你有聞到燒焦味嗎？」。答案選C，因為忘記關瓦斯爐會導致東西燒焦，情境最合理。干擾項A將burning過度聯想為抽菸；B說燒焦味很香並不合常理；D道歉表示無意傷人則是答非所問。

questions.stem: Have you ever read any manga?

options.A: Yes, I'm really into Japanese comic books.
options.B: No, I've never been to Japan.
options.C: Yes, I'm familiar with Japanese tea ceremony.
options.D: No, I've never read any Japanese newspapers.

questions.explain:
manga: 日本漫畫
be into: 喜愛、對...感興趣
comic book: 漫畫書
解析：題意詢問「你看過任何日本漫畫嗎？」，manga 便是指日本漫畫。A 選項回答「有，我很喜歡日本漫畫」，語意完全切合，故答案選A。B、C、D 選項皆為日本文化的相關聯想陷阱，分別提及去日本、茶道及報紙，偏離了詢問「漫畫」的主題，皆不正確。

questions.stem: Where can I buy some garden tools?
questions.explain:
garden tools: 園藝工具
hardware store: 五金行
pharmacy: 藥局
grocery store: 食品雜貨店
解析：題目詢問哪裡可以買到園藝工具。工具類用品應前往五金行購買，故答案選D。選項A藥局販售藥品、B雜貨店販售食材日用品、C汽車旅館為住宿場所，皆非購買工具的地點。

questions.stem: Can I sublet the apartment to someone else?

options.A: Yes, you can rent the apartment.
options.B: No, I won't let you go away.
options.D: No, didn't you read the lease?

questions.explain:
sublet: 轉租
lease: 租約
解析：題目詢問「我可以把公寓轉租給別人嗎？」。轉租規定通常載於租約中，D選項反問「你沒看租約嗎？」最符合邏輯，故答案選D。A選項答非所問；B選項借由let設下字面與發音陷阱；C選項提到裝潢則與轉租無關。

questions.stem: Is Lyon a big city in France?

options.A: Yes, it's the third largest city in France.
options.D: No, I prefer Paris to Lyon.

questions.explain:
largest: 最大的
prefer A to B: 喜歡A勝過B
解析：題目詢問里昂是否為法國的大城市。A選項正面肯定並補充是第三大城，符合邏輯，故答案選A。C前後矛盾（答Yes卻說是小鎮）；B說沒去過、D表達個人偏好，皆屬答非所問的干擾項。

questions.stem: Which of the following military units is responsible for building fortifications?
questions.explain:
engineer battalion: 工兵營
fortification: 防禦工事
artillery battalion: 砲兵營
解析：題意詢問何者負責建造防禦工事。工兵營的專長即為築城、工事與各類阻絕設置，故答案選A。干擾選項中，B通信營負責通訊聯絡、C砲兵營負責火力支援、D醫療營負責傷患救護，皆與工程構築無關。

questions.stem: Does the party have a dress code?

options.A: No, the party isn't open to everyone.
options.C: No, it's not that cold tonight.
options.D: Yes, the party begins at 7 p.m.

questions.explain:
dress code: 服裝規定
formal dress: 正式服裝
require: 要求、規定
解析：題目詢問派對是否有著裝規定，答案選B，說明必須穿著正式服裝，符合題意。干擾選項C利用code與cold發音相近設下聽力陷阱；D回答派對時間，A回答參加資格，皆答非所問。

questions.stem: What's your favorite pastime?

options.C: Buying lottery tickets has become a national pastime.

questions.explain:
pastime: 消遣、嗜好
online game: 線上遊戲
lottery ticket: 彩券
解析：題目詢問你最喜歡的休閒消遣是什麼。B選項回答玩線上遊戲，符合個人嗜好，故答案選B。A與D回答季節與月份，是利用 favorite 設下的答非所問陷阱；C雖出現 pastime 一字，但陳述的是買彩券的普遍現象，並非回答自己的消遣。

questions.stem: Your handwriting is illegible.

options.B: Your handwriting is easy to imitate.
options.C: Your handwriting is one of a kind.
options.D: Your handwriting is very difficult to read.

questions.explain:
handwriting: 筆跡、字跡
illegible: 難以辨識的、字跡模糊的
imitate: 模仿
解析：題意為「你的字跡難以辨認」。illegible 指文字難以看懂，與 difficult to read 同義，故答案選D。選項A意思恰好相反；選項B的 imitate（模仿）與選項C（獨一無二）皆曲解題意，為無關的字義干擾項。

questions.stem: The hurricane's momentum is increasing.

options.A: The hurricane is picking up speed.
options.B: The hurricane has caused serious damage.
options.D: The hurricane has run its course.

questions.explain:
momentum: 動量、動能
pick up speed: 加快速度
run its course: 走完全程、結束
解析：題意指颶風的動能持續增強。momentum 表動量或衝力，增加即代表速度變快，故答案選A。選項B的造成損害與C的方向難以預測皆非原句涵義；D指颶風已走到尾聲，與持續增強的語意完全相反。

questions.stem: I felt like a fish out of water at the formal dinner.

options.A: I felt honored to be able to attend the formal dinner.
options.B: I had a good time at the formal dinner.
options.C: I felt uncomfortable at the formal dinner.
options.D: I ate my fill at the formal dinner.

questions.explain:
a fish out of water: 感到不自在、格格不入
formal dinner: 正式晚宴
eat one's fill: 吃飽
解析：題意為「我在正式晚宴上感到很不自在」。慣用語 a fish out of water 字面是離水的魚，比喻人在特定環境感到格格不入，故答案選C（感到不自在）。干擾選項A感到榮幸與B玩得愉快皆與原意相反；D吃得很飽則是將 fish 誤導為食物的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: A lot of people came to cheer on the host team.

options.A: A lot of people supported the host team.
options.B: A lot of people hated the host team.
options.C: A lot of people took pictures of the host team.
options.D: A lot of people sympathized with the host team.

questions.explain:
cheer on: 為...加油、支持
host team: 主隊
sympathize with: 同情
解析：題幹指「許多人來為主隊加油」。片語 cheer on 即為支持（support），故答案選A。選項 B 的 hate（討厭）意思相反；C 的拍照與 D 的同情皆非 cheer on 的涵義，屬於語義干擾。

questions.stem: What he will do next is anyone's guess.

options.A: Everyone is guessing what he will do next.
options.B: No one knows what he will do next.
options.C: He will invite more guests next time.
options.D: He will invite fewer guests next time.

questions.explain:
anyone's guess: 誰也不知道的事
guest: 客人
解析：題目意為「他下一步要做什麼，誰都不知道」。「anyone's guess」為固定片語，表示無人知曉或無法預測，故答案選B。選項A為字面直譯陷阱，並非指大家都在猜測；選項C和D則是利用 guess 與音近字 guest（客人）來混淆考生。

questions.stem: Kevin became an orphan at the age of 5.

options.A: He lost both parents at the age of 5.
options.B: He attended elementary school at the age of 5.
options.C: He was a prodigy at the age of 5.
options.D: He escaped from an orphanage at the age of 5.

questions.explain:
orphan: 孤兒
orphanage: 孤兒院
prodigy: 神童
解析：題意指凱文五歲時成為孤兒。orphan指失去雙親的孩子，故答案選A。干擾選項D出現orphanage（孤兒院），屬於同字根的字面陷阱且原句未提逃跑；B上小學與C神童則與題意無關。

questions.stem: Don't drive under the influence.

options.A: Don't drive when the weather is bad.
options.B: Don't drive when traffic is heavy.
options.C: Don't drive when you are in a bad mood.
options.D: Don't drive when you are drunk.

questions.explain:
under the influence: 在酒精或藥物影響下（酒醉）
drunk: 酒醉的
解析：片語 under the influence 專指在酒類或藥物作用下開車，即「酒駕」，因此答案選D。選項A惡劣天氣、B交通擁擠、C心情不好，皆為字面聯想的干擾項，非該片語的固定涵義。

questions.stem: The shopping mall is a one-stop store.

options.A: They have almost everything you need for sale.
options.B: They have many bus stops in the shopping mall.
options.C: The shopping mall is closed for one day.
options.D: The shopping mall is reopening in one or two days.

questions.explain:
one-stop: 一站式的、應有盡有的
shopping mall: 大型購物中心
for sale: 販售中
解析：題幹說這家商場是「一站式商店」，指在此就能買齊所需物品，故答案選A。干擾選項B利用stop誘導聯想到公車站牌(bus stops)，C與D則從one字面聯想成休息或重開「一天(one day)」，均為ALCPT常見的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: Mary is wavering between going to graduate school and getting a job.

options.A: Mary wants to get a job after she graduates.
options.B: Mary wants to get a job before she gets married.
options.C: Mary can't decide whether to go to graduate school or get a job.
options.D: Mary can't go to graduate school because she has a job.

questions.explain:
waver between: 在…之間猶豫不決
graduate school: 研究所
解析：題意為瑪莉在讀研究所和找工作之間猶豫不決。片語 waver between 表示難以抉擇，等同 C 的 can't decide，故答案選C。干擾選項 A 與 D 扭曲了事情的先後及因果關係；B 則利用發音相近的 married 混淆人名 Mary。

questions.stem: Mr. Lewis is an asset to our company.

options.A: He is a foolish person in our company.
options.B: He is a senior accountant in our company.
options.C: He is an auditor in our company.
options.D: He is a valuable person in our company.

questions.explain:
asset: 有價值的人或資產
valuable: 有價值的、寶貴的
解析：題幹 asset 指對組織有貢獻、有價值的人才，因此答案選D。干擾選項 B（會計師）與 C（審計員）是利用 asset 在商業會計中常指「資產」所設下的字面聯想陷阱；A 的 foolish（愚蠢的）則與題意完全相反。

questions.stem: Mary is hosting a news program on TV.
questions.explain:
host: 主持
anchorwoman: 新聞女主播
acquaintance: 相識的人
解析：題意為瑪莉正在電視上主持新聞節目。主持新聞者即為女主播，故答案選A。選項B電腦工程師與C樂觀者皆偏離題意；選項D新相識的人則是利用 new 與題目 news 的字形相似來混淆視聽。

questions.stem: That restaurant has gone out of business.

options.A: That restaurant has a lot of local patrons.
options.C: That restaurant is expanding their business.
options.D: That restaurant is not far from here.

questions.explain:
go out of business: 歇業、倒閉
close down: 倒閉、停業
expand: 擴大、擴充
解析：題意為「那家餐廳已經歇業了」。片語 go out of business 與 closed down 同義，故答案選B。選項C出現原題的 business 設下字面陷阱，但 expanding 意思是擴大經營，語意正好相反；A與D則與停業無關。

questions.stem: Let's divide the steak between us.

options.A: Let's order a steak for each of us.
options.B: Let's split the bill between us.
options.C: Let's go to a steak house instead.

questions.explain:
divide: 分開、平分
steak: 牛排
share: 分享、合吃
解析：題意為「我們平分這塊牛排吧」。divide between us 表示兩人平分共吃，與 share 同義，故答案選D。選項B的 split the bill 為平分帳單的常見情境干擾；選項A為各自點一份牛排，選項C為改去牛排館，皆偏離原句題意。

questions.stem: We're planning to build more barracks.

options.A: We're planning to build more power plants.
options.B: We're planning to build more bridges.
options.C: We're planning to build more houses for our soldiers.
options.D: We're planning to build more hotels.

questions.explain:
barracks: 營房、兵營
plan to: 計畫
power plant: 發電廠
解析：題意為「我們計畫建造更多營房」。barracks 是軍事核心單字，指軍人的住所，同義於 houses for our soldiers，故答案選C。選項 A 發電廠、B 橋梁、D 飯店皆非軍用住宿設施，為常見建築名詞的替換干擾。

questions.stem: I report directly to Captain Taylor.

options.A: Captain Taylor is my immediate superior.
options.B: Captain Taylor is a war correspondent.
options.D: Captain Taylor is a good companion.

questions.explain:
report to: 向...報告；隸屬於...
immediate superior: 直屬長官
subordinate: 部屬、下屬
解析：題目表示「我直接向泰勒上尉報告」，代表對方是自己的直屬長官，故答案選A。干擾選項C的subordinate是「下屬」，階級完全相反；B的correspondent（記者）是用report的字面意思設置陷阱；D的companion（同伴）則無法表達軍中的上下級隸屬關係。

questions.stem: Margaret is deep into Chinese calligraphy.

options.A: She is very interested in Chinese geography.
options.B: She is very interested in Chinese characters.
options.C: She is very interested in Chinese history.
options.D: She is very interested in Chinese literature.

questions.explain:
be deep into: 深深著迷於
calligraphy: 書法
Chinese characters: 漢字
解析：題意指瑪格麗特對中國書法非常著迷。書法是書寫漢字的藝術，故答案選B。選項A的geography（地理）為字尾發音相近的陷阱，選項C歷史與D文學則非書法核心概念。

questions.stem: They are waiting at the boarding gate.

options.A: They are waiting on a few guests.
options.B: They are waiting for the signal.
options.C: They are about to get on the plane.
options.D: They are about to enter the zoo.

questions.explain:
boarding gate: 登機門
be about to: 即將
wait on: 服侍、侍候
解析：題意為「他們正在登機門等候」。在登機門代表即將登機，與 get on the plane 意思相符，故答案選C。選項A的 wait on 是「服侍」，與在某處等候無關；選項B的「等信號」及選項D的「進動物園」均脫離機場情境，為無關干擾項。

questions.stem: That man is a homeless person.

options.B: He is a very valuable person.
options.C: He has a lot of money to burn.

questions.explain:
homeless: 無家可歸的
residence: 住所、住宅
money to burn: 錢多到花不完
解析：題意為「那個男人是個無家可歸的人」。homeless 指沒有家，等同於「沒有固定住所（no fixed residence）」，故答案選A。選項 B（有價值的）、C（非常有錢）、D（可靠的）語意皆與街友無關，純屬無關干擾。

questions.stem: They did not reach the camp until suppertime.

options.A: They did not reach the camp on time.
options.B: They arrived at the camp in the evening.
options.C: They did not set out yet.
options.D: They arrived at the camp the next morning.

questions.explain:
reach: 到達
suppertime: 晚餐時間
not... until...: 直到…才…
解析：題意指「他們直到晚餐時間才抵達營區」。「suppertime」指傍晚晚餐時刻，與 in the evening 意思相近，故答案選B。選項A說沒準時、C說尚未出發、D說隔天早上才到，皆為扭曲時間細節的干擾項。

questions.stem: Give me a hot dog, and hold the mustard, please.

options.A: I don't want a hot dog.
options.B: I use a MasterCard when shopping around.
options.D: I like to keep dogs as pets.

questions.explain:
hold: 不要加、省略
mustard: 芥末醬
解析：點餐時 hold 表示不要加某種配料，題意為「給我一份熱狗，不要加芥末」，故答案選C。A與題意相反；B為 mustard 與 MasterCard 的發音陷阱；D則是把 hot dog 誤解為寵物狗的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: Those soldiers are in need of more drills.
questions.explain:
be in need of: 需要
drill: 軍事訓練、操練
解析：題意為「那些士兵需要更多操練」。軍事用語 drill 意為部隊操練或訓練，與 training 同義，故答案選D。干擾項 A 裝備、B 鼓勵、C 醫療照護皆偏離了 drill 的軍事實務字義。

questions.stem: A lot of men find Nancy irresistible.

options.A: A lot of men think Nancy is very capable.
options.B: A lot of men think Nancy is very snobbish.
options.C: A lot of men think Nancy is very timid.
options.D: A lot of men think Nancy is very attractive.

questions.explain:
irresistible: 極具吸引力的、無法抗拒的
attractive: 迷人的、有吸引力的
snobbish: 勢利的、傲慢的
解析：題意為「許多男人覺得南西令人無法抗拒」。irresistible 形容人時表示極具魅力、無法抗拒，與 attractive 同義，故答案選D。干擾選項 A 的 capable（有能力的）、B 的 snobbish（勢利的）與 C 的 timid（膽小的）皆屬不同特質的詞彙，與題意完全不符。

questions.stem: The headache I had last night was not imaginary.

options.A: The headache I had last night has come back.
options.B: The headache I had last night has gone away.
options.C: The headache I had last night was not serious enough.
options.D: The headache I had last night was real.

questions.explain:
imaginary: 想像的、虛構的
real: 真實的
解析：題意為「我昨晚的頭痛不是憑空想像的」，not imaginary 即表示痛楚是「真實的」，故答案選D。選項A（頭痛復發）與B（頭痛消失）是臆測後續狀況的干擾項；選項C（不夠嚴重）則完全扭曲原意。

questions.stem: Michael set his alarm for five o'clock.

options.A: He got off work at five o'clock.
options.B: He needed to get up at five o'clock.
options.C: He went to bed at five o'clock.

questions.explain:
set an alarm: 設定鬧鐘
get up: 起床
get off work: 下班
解析：題意為麥可設了五點的鬧鐘，表示他要在五點起床，故答案選B。選項A下班與C上床睡覺皆與設鬧鐘是為了起床的目的不符，D選項職業軍人則是無關的干擾訊息。

questions.stem: The novel was written by an obscure author.

options.A: The author of the novel was a genius.
options.B: The author of the novel was not famous.
options.C: The author of the novel won an award.
options.D: The author of the novel won international acclaim.

questions.explain:
novel: 小說
obscure: 沒沒無聞的、不出名的
acclaim: 稱讚、讚譽
解析：題意為「這部小說是由一位沒沒無聞的作家所寫」。關鍵字 obscure 意指「鮮為人知、不出名」，等同於 not famous，故答案選B。選項A的天才、C的得獎及D的獲得國際讚揚，都與「沒沒無聞」語意相反，為反向干擾選項。

questions.stem: M:You look worried. Is something on your mind? W:My sister and I had a fight yesterday. I said something that may have hurt her feelings. Q:What happened between the woman and her sister?

options.A: They were hurt in an accident.
options.B: They could not find their way home.
options.C: They were robbed at the bank.

turns.t: You look worried. Is something on your mind?
My sister and I had a fight yesterday. I said something that may have hurt her feelings.
What happened between the woman and her sister?

questions.explain:
on one's mind: 有心事；掛念
have a fight: 吵架；爭吵
hurt one's feelings: 傷害某人的感情
解析：女子表示昨天和姊妹吵架，had a fight即had an argument的同義代換，故答案選D。干擾選項A利用對話中出現的hurt設下字面陷阱，將心理受傷曲解為遭遇意外而受傷；B與C對話中完全未提及。

questions.stem: W:Why do a lot of people wear blue jeans? M:They last longer, I think. Q:What does the man mean?

turns.t: Why do a lot of people wear blue jeans?
They last longer, I think.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
last: 持久、耐用
durable: 耐用的
showy: 招搖的、引人注目的
解析：女士詢問大家愛穿牛仔褲的原因，男士回答「They last longer」，意指牛仔褲穿得較久、不易損壞。durable 是 last 的同義代換詞，表示耐用的，故答案選B。選項A便宜、C低調不炫耀、D更時髦皆非男士提到的理由，屬於常識推論的干擾選項。

questions.stem: W:What does your father do? M:He used to be a bus driver, but now he raises cows for milk. Q:How does the man's father make a living now?

turns.t: What does your father do?
He used to be a bus driver, but now he raises cows for milk.
How does the man's father make a living now?

questions.explain:
used to: 過去曾經
make a living: 謀生
dairy farmer: 酪農
解析：題意詢問父親現在如何謀生。男子表示父親「現在養牛產奶」，即指酪農，故答案選B。選項A是他過去的職業，屬於過去與現在的時間陷阱；選項C計程車司機與D蔬菜農夫則與對話內容不符。

questions.stem: M:Let's take a break and have some coffee. W:I wish I could. M:What keeps you so busy? W:I need to get everything done for the meeting in the afternoon. Q: Why is the woman so busy?

options.C: She is making preparations for a meeting.

turns.t: Let's take a break and have some coffee.
I wish I could.
What keeps you so busy?
I need to get everything done for the meeting in the afternoon.
Why is the woman so busy?

questions.explain:
take a break: 休息
get ... done: 完成某事
make preparations: 進行準備
解析：女士提到下午要開會，必須把所有事情處理完，也就是在為會議做準備，因此答案選C。A與B為男士提議喝咖啡休息，女士並未去做；D選項提到見客戶（clients），對話中並未提及，屬於過度推論的干擾選項。

questions.stem: M:I'm so hungry; I can't wait for the lecture to end. W:Neither can I. I'm bored to tears. Q:How does the woman feel about the lecture?

options.D: It makes the woman feel like crying.

turns.t: I'm so hungry; I can't wait for the lecture to end.
Neither can I. I'm bored to tears.
How does the woman feel about the lecture?

questions.explain:
lecture: 演講、授課
bored to tears: 無聊透頂
tedious: 乏味的、無聊的
解析：男士說希望演講快結束，女士附和並表示 bored to tears（無聊透頂）。tedious 與 bored 同義，故答案選A。選項D為字面陷阱，把 tears 誤解為想哭；C意思完全相反；B提到生氣與文意不符。

questions.stem: W:My brother wants to buy stocks now. What should I tell him to do? M:Tell him to hold his horses. Stocks will be cheaper in a few weeks. Q:What does the man mean?

options.A: It's not the right time to buy stocks now.
options.B: Stocks are already very cheap now.
options.D: Stock prices may rise in a few weeks.

turns.t: My brother wants to buy stocks now. What should I tell him to do?
Tell him to hold his horses. Stocks will be cheaper in a few weeks.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
hold one's horses: 稍安勿躁、別急
stock: 股票
解析：男士用 hold his horses 勸對方哥哥先別急，因幾週後股票會更便宜，代表現在不是買進的好時機，答案選A。選項B與現在還不夠便宜相反；選項D說價格幾週後會上漲（rise），與男士說的會更便宜（cheaper）意思完全相反。

questions.stem: W:What seems to be the problem, sir? M: Well, I ordered a fish burger, but you gave me the chicken burger. Q:Where is the man?

turns.t: What seems to be the problem, sir?
Well, I ordered a fish burger, but you gave me the chicken burger.
Where is the man?

questions.explain:
order: 點餐
fish burger: 魚排堡
fast food restaurant: 速食店
解析：對話中男子說他點了魚排堡卻拿到雞肉堡，問男子人在哪裡。漢堡是常見速食，故答案選B。選項A魚市場與C養雞場是藉由對話中提到的fish與chicken設計的字面陷阱；D理髮店則與點餐情境完全無關。

questions.stem: M:Two hundred dollars is too expensive for me. W:I'll give you a 5% discount if you pay cash. M:OK. Q:How much will the man have to pay if he pays cash?

turns.t: Two hundred dollars is too expensive for me.
I'll give you a 5% discount if you pay cash.
OK.
How much will the man have to pay if he pays cash?

questions.explain:
discount: 折扣
pay cash: 付現
expensive: 昂貴的
解析：女士說付現可打5%折扣。原價200元的5%為10元，扣除後應付190元，故答案選A。BCD選項皆為算錯折扣率（誤算成10%、15%或20%折扣）的計算陷阱。

questions.stem: W: Wow, you look so cool on that thing! M: Want a ride? W: Sure. M: Hop on! Here's a helmet. Q: What is the man most likely riding?

turns.t: Wow, you look so cool on that thing!
Want a ride?
Sure.
Hop on! Here's a helmet.
What is the man most likely riding?

questions.explain:
hop on: 跳上去、上車
helmet: 安全帽
want a ride: 想搭便車嗎
解析：男士說「Hop on」（上車）並遞給女士「helmet」（安全帽），能載人且需戴安全帽的交通工具為機車，故答案選C。選項A馬與B駱駝是動物不需安全帽，D獨輪車通常無法雙載，皆不符對話情境。

questions.stem: M: What do we need to make the cake? W: I've got some eggs and flour, but we also need sugar. Can you pick up some on your way home? Q: Where is the man likely to go before getting home?

turns.t: What do we need to make the cake?
I've got some eggs and flour, but we also need sugar. Can you pick up some on your way home?
Where is the man likely to go before getting home?

questions.explain:
flour: 麵粉
pick up: 順便買、提取
grocery store: 雜貨店、食品超市
解析：女士請男士回家途中順便買做蛋糕用的糖，買食材應去食品雜貨店，故答案選C。選項A理髮店、B美容院及D自行車行皆不販售烘焙食材，為生活場所的干擾選項。

questions.stem: We______eat out on weekends because we enjoy cooking at home.
questions.explain:
選a. rarely(很少地;幾乎不) 因為後面句子告訴我們說話者很享受煮飯樂趣; 其
他選項都表肯定意思

questions.stem: We need to conduct a market ______ as soon as possible.
questions.explain: conduct (v.) 表”進行”/”實施”的意思; a survey (n.) 為”調查”之意

questions.stem: ______will the effects of the sandstorm last?
questions.explain: last (v.)表持續的動作, 選 How long? (多久時間)

questions.stem: There were five bridesmaids, four of______I recognized as the bride's classmates.
questions.explain:
a. them (選them時前面應該有連接詞, 後面要有動詞)
b. which 不用在指人
c. 當recognized的受格用, 標準答案
d. that 前面不接逗號

questions.stem: You must admit the cheesecake is pleasant______your taste buds.
questions.explain: be.v. pleasant to + n. (令人愉快的)

questions.stem: Water_____is a major problem in many areas of the world.
questions.explain: c. deficiency (=not having enough 缺乏, 不足)

questions.stem: ______she may have just turned 40, Ruby still looks young and beautiful.
questions.explain: 選C Although; 因前後句子有相反之意

questions.stem: There is a demilitarized ______between North Korea and South Korea.
questions.explain: a demilitarized zone 非軍事區; 停火區 (zone這裡表區域的意思, 為專有名詞)

questions.stem: A general is______to a colonel in rank.
questions.explain:
be.v. higher (lower) than …(higher or lower需接than; 比較級用法)
Be.v. superior or inferior 後接to

questions.stem: The traffic gradually ______to a halt because there was a roadblock ahead.
questions.explain:
grind to a halt = stop gradually 慢慢停下來;逐漸陷入停頓 (grind三態動詞變化
為 grind-ground-ground)

questions.stem: Even though the economy has shown some signs of recovery, most experts______ pessimistic.
questions.explain: remain (v.) 停留，留下；保持不變，仍然是(狀態)

questions.stem: The traffic problems are caused by many vehicles double parked ______the city streets.
questions.explain: along (preposition) 沿著，順著，循著

questions.stem: Since it was a national holiday, I______in bed until noon.
questions.explain:
national holiday: 國定假日
stay in bed: 賴床、躺在床上
until noon: 直到中午
解析：題意為「因為是國定假日，我賴床直到中午。」前半句從屬連接詞引導的子句使用過去式 was，主要子句描述過去發生的單純動作，時態需一致使用過去簡單式，故答案選B。選項A為現在式時態不合；選項C現在完成式不可用於純過去事件；選項D過去完成式需有更晚的過去動作做先後對照，在此不適用。

questions.stem: Most of our factory workers are hired on a full-time______.
questions.explain: b. on a full-time basis 以…為基礎; 以…為根據

questions.stem: Take some more money with you _______you need to buy a few other things.
questions.explain: d. in case 以防

questions.stem: Patients in the ICU need ______24 hours a day.
questions.explain: need + Ving

questions.stem: It seemed to take______for our bags to arrive on the baggage carousel.
questions.explain: a,b,c 選項後不接介係詞; 因此選D forever

questions.stem: Look, this shirt ______me like a glove!
questions.explain: fit(s) 人 like a glove 合身

questions.stem: Are you able to distinguish______the twin sisters?
questions.explain: a. distinguish between…在兩者之間做出區別, 需用介係詞between

questions.stem: You must be______if you think you can get away with it.
questions.explain: You must be kidding if…(你一定是開玩笑你可以規避這件事!)

questions.stem: Before I got married, I didn't ______having to do the cooking myself.
questions.explain:
anticipate後接名詞或動名詞; 其他選項 expect + to; participate +in;
inspect(v.)”檢查””審視” 與句意不符

questions.stem: The lecture ______to us by the professor for the last five classes.
questions.explain:
has been taught 表現在完成被動態 課被這個professor教; 持續五堂課用完成
示

questions.stem: I could______believe my ears when Helen said she was in love with me.
questions.explain: hardly 幾乎不

questions.stem: The topic is too sensitive. I wish you_______it.
questions.explain:
(a)（與過去時連用，對已經存在的情況表示遺憾）但願，希望
例子: I wish (that) I was/were a bit taller.我個子再高一點就好了。
(b)（與過去完成時連用，對過去某事表示悔恨）例子: I wish (that) I hadn't
eaten so much. 我真希望自己沒吃那麼多。

questions.stem: In a few years, our current weapons system will give way to a more _____one.
questions.explain:
a. 標準答案
b.c.d.不符合句意

questions.stem: Check the______date before you buy any food products or beverages.
questions.explain: expiration date 有效日期

questions.stem: _______the existing law, it is illegal to discriminate against women at work.
questions.explain: under the law 根據法律規定; 介係詞要用 “under”

questions.stem: The government armies were ________by the enemy.
questions.explain: were pinned down 表 “使（某人）動彈不得；困住（某人）”

questions.stem: ______rapidly the disease is spreading across the country!
questions.explain: C. How 最為適當; 選項AD後面需接名詞; B. Far 不當句首

questions.stem: If there______a power failure, we would have finished on time.
questions.explain: 選D. had not been; 因是與過去事實相反, 用過去完成式

questions.stem: Sheep's milk is richer than______goat's or cow's milk.
questions.explain:
a. both…and…
b. either…or…(正確答案)
c. neither…nor…

questions.explain:
d. 標準答案
a,b,c 不符合句意

questions.stem: A lot of local people took shelter in the cave during the air______.
questions.explain: an air raid 表”空襲”; an air raid shelter (防空洞)

questions.stem: A lot of customers rushed out of the supermarket as soon as the fire alarm________.
questions.explain:
The alarm should go off automatically as soon as smoke is detected.警報器
一旦測出有煙就會自動鳴響。其他選項:
a. came off (come off) 取得預期的效果；成功
b. came out (come out) 發行;出版;出來
d. went out (go out) 出門參加社交活動; 熄滅

questions.stem: Humans have turned to nature for medicine since ancient times. The earth's oceans may be the best source. Though at least 26 drugs that come from marine organisms are currently on the market or in development, a lot of biochemists are trying to boost the number. Which of the following is closest in meaning to the word ''boost''?
questions.explain:
boost: 提高、增加
marine organism: 海洋生物
解析：題意指生化學家正努力提高海洋藥物數量。boost 表「增加、促進」，與 increase 同義，故答案選A。選項 B 為反義詞（減少）的陷阱；C（計算）與 D（折扣）則不合文意且為字形與詞意干擾。

questions.stem: Over the past few years, social networking has developed into a craze. Millions of people around the world use social networking sites on a daily basis. But what exactly is social networking? Joining a social networking site is a lot like going to a new school. On your first day of school, you don't know anyone. You make a friend or two after your first classes. Then, you join a few groups, and suddenly you have a lot of friends. Which of the following is a social networking site?
questions.explain:
social networking: 社群網路
craze: 風潮、狂熱
on a daily basis: 每天
解析：題幹介紹社群網路的興起與運作方式，最後詢問何者為社群網站。Facebook（臉書）是著名的社群平台，故答案選A。干擾選項中，The Red Cross 是人道組織紅十字會，Burger King 是速食連鎖店漢堡王，The United Nations 則是國際政治組織聯合國，均非網路社群。

questions.stem: Ebola is a viral disease of which the initial symptoms can include a sudden fever, intense fatigue, muscle pain and a sore throat, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). And that is just the beginning. Subsequent stages are vomiting, diarrhea and - in some cases - both internal and external bleeding. According to the passage, which is an initial symptom of the Ebola disease?
questions.explain:
initial symptom: 初期症狀
intense fatigue: 極度疲勞
subsequent: 後續的
解析：題目問伊波拉病毒的初期症狀為何。文中指出初期症狀包含 intense fatigue，與選項 A 的 Extreme tiredness 同義，故答案選 A。選項 C 與 D 屬於後續階段的症狀，並非初期症狀；選項 B 則是文中完全未提及的干擾選項。

questions.stem: 98. Couch surfing is a remarkable way to travel, and travelers of all budgets can benefit from it. The term ''couch surfing'' simply refers to staying with hosts while you travel. You can find free accommodations ranging from simple couches to spare bedrooms. Not only can you go everywhere for sightseeing but you can also make a lot of new friends. The best part of couch surfing, however, is that it can dramatically lower your traveling expenses. According to the passage, couch surfing is especially suitable for people .
questions.explain:
couch surfing: 沙發衝浪（免費借宿）
budget: 預算
expense: 費用、支出
解析：文章提到沙發衝浪提供免費住宿，能大幅降低旅遊花費，因此最適合預算有限的人，答案選B。選項A獨自旅行與C與朋友同行文中皆非強調重點；D有安全顧慮者更不適合住陌生人家，為反向干擾選項。

questions.stem: Myanmar is in a good position to make big gains in Asia's fast-growing markets. But the country may have a long way to go. After 50 years of military rule, it is one of Asia's poorest countries. Roads, bridges and railways are in urgent need of development before it can attract foreign investment. Based on the passage, what does Myanmar need most?
questions.explain:
infrastructure: 基礎建設
urgent need: 急迫需求
foreign investment: 外國投資
解析：題目問緬甸目前最需要什麼。文章提到道路、橋樑與鐵路急需發展，這些皆屬於基礎建設，因此答案選B。干擾選項A天然資源與D自由貿易在文中並未提及；C民主制度雖提到過去有軍事統治歷史，但並非文中所指吸引外資最迫切需要的發展項目。
